answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in trellis, expire in orchard, and horizon lists each expiry. An farming party running 78 aliases therefore needs 144 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 119 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
